description.value: Pho Super Bowl is a Vietnamese restaurant on the Kingsway corridor in Burnaby, one of two Metro Vancouver locations alongside Coquitlam. The restaurant specializes in pho — an aromatic rice noodle soup — alongside vermicelli bowls, rice plates, and appetizers, emphasizing fresh, healthy Vietnamese cuisine built around a long-developed house recipe. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online ordering with delivery and pickup is offered.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Vietnamese restaurant at 5505 Kingsway, Burnaby, with phone and address matching OSM exactly. Online ordering with pickup is explicitly promoted on the website ('ORDER ONLINE', 'Straight to Your Door', and the menu URL includes orderType=Pickup), confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags; OSM records outdoor_seating=yes but this does not constitute evidence of bike parking or visibility.
